Marta: Grove pilot kickoff — quick sync Thurs 10am PT? Need: enrollment list, intake form, and top 3 metrics to track. @owen can you confirm integration checklist availability? :calendar:
Owen: I can bring the checklist. We support batch uploads and webhooks. Which model variant are they testing?
Marta: Starting with small-hosted variant (2 vCPUs). Link to intake: https://redwood.internal/docs/grove-intake — use the 'pilot' template.
Riley: When can we open seats? Grove wanted to start sending test prompts next week.
Priya: I'll prepare a 30-min enablement script + sample prompts. Can someone share a customer success playbook for quick wins?
Sasha: FYI, finance flagged potential renewal risk — Grove asked about committed discounts already. We should log negotiation points.
Riley: Noted. For quick wins: set up 1) classifier for support triage 2) FAQ bot with caching 3) embeddings for search. Those are fast to demo.
Owen: Integration checklist: webhook examples and sample payloads in this gist: https://gist.github.com/example. I'll paste minimal curl for their engs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/pilot/infer \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
 -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Priya: Sending draft enablement slide deck now to the shared folder. @marta can you add Grove's POC emails to the invite list?
Marta: Added grove_poc@grove.co, k.im@grove.co, and ops@grove.co. Enrollment list: 3 engineers + 2 PMs. Confirmed seats = 5.
Sasha: I'll open a renewal risk ticket (CS-4321) and add negotiation owner. Tagging @priya to surface pricing levers in the enablement.
Priya: Will include pricing bullets and fallback offers (short term credits, usage threshold bump).
Marta: Great. Action items: Owen = integration checklist + curl samples, Priya = enablement + pricing bullets, Riley = quick-win demo configs, Sasha = renewal ticket and finance liaison. Meeting Thurs 10am PT. Ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
Owen: Got it.
Riley: On it.
Sasha: Opening ticket now.
Priya: Slide deck uploaded.
Marta: Thanks team — I'll post a short post-kickoff survey for Grove and capture feedback in the pilot folder.
